prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
competitors_mentioned: Alameda County Bar Association’s Lawyer Referral Service
State Bar of California Attorney Search
answer_verbatim:
I can’t responsibly name one “best” lawyer without knowing the details of your injuries and case. A good first step is the **Alameda County Bar Association’s Lawyer Referral Service**: it refers people with vehicle-injury claims to qualified, insured attorneys. It currently lists a **$40 administrative fee** and an initial consultation of up to 30 minutes. You can request a referral at [acbanet.org/need-a-lawyer](https://www.acbanet.org/need-a-lawyer/) or call **(510) 302-2222, option 1**.

When you speak with lawyers, compare a few and ask:
- How much of your practice involves car-injury cases like yours?
- Who will handle your case day to day, and have they taken similar cases to trial?
- What is the contingency fee, and which case costs might you owe?
- What are the main strengths, risks, and deadlines in your claim?

Before hiring, check the lawyer’s license and disciplinary history using the [State Bar of California Attorney Search](https://apps.calbar.ca.gov/attorney/LicenseeSearch/QuickSearch). Don’t feel pressured to sign during the first call.

If you tell me how serious your injuries are, whether fault is disputed, and whether an insurer has made an offer, I can help you prepare questions for consultations.
